name: gpace-step-58-offline-performance
limitations: The Node harness does not measure browser rendering, CLS, INP, or LCP; no browser render budget is inferred from these results.
No Firebase Auth or Firestore emulator is started; backend jobs use injected in-memory repositories and workers only.
The report records the local Node and hardware profile. Browser device variance and contention require a separate browser run before release claims.
